# Dataset

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Dataset`](gmeow-Dataset.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Dataset>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A collection of data published as a unit. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Dataset`](gmeow-Dataset.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Lillith Dataset

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/graphrag/examples/lillith-dataset.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/graphrag/examples/lillith-dataset.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-graphrag-examples-lillith-dataset)#example-slices-extensions-graphrag-examples-lillith-dataset

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# The dataset descriptor for the Lillith worked example: the
# gmeow:Dataset node that the research-object exports (Croissant, RO-Crate,
# DCAT, DataCite, Frictionless) read their catalog metadata FROM — title,
# description, licence, attribution, publication date. Canonical instance
# data; every export is a generated lossy projection of it (P4/P5).
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/graphrag/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:lillith-benchmark a gmeow:Dataset ;
    rdfs:label "Lillith GraphRAG benchmark"@en ;
    gmeow:title "Lillith GraphRAG benchmark"@en ;
    gmeow:description "A worked GraphRAG benchmark dataset: a content-addressed corpus, its chunking, embeddings, vector index, retrieval events, and model-extracted entity/relationship descriptions — every artifact attributed and confidence-weighted, published as a research object."@en ;
    gmeow:hasPart ex:corpus-lillith ;
    gmeow:hasLicense ex:lillith-license ;
    gmeow:wasAttributedTo ex:blackcat ;
    gmeow:datePublished "2026-06-12T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:sourceLocation "https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/graphrag/lillith-benchmark" .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a data collection published as a citable unit — a research dataset, statistical release, or open-data corpus at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for an ongoing ordered stream of feed items (use [`gmeow:DataFeed`](gmeow-DataFeed.md)) and avoid it for a single downloadable file of the dataset (that is a [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) / distribution).

### How to use

- Type the dataset [`gmeow:Dataset`](gmeow-Dataset.md), carry its DOI on [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) and [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) / bibliographic dates; expose concrete download files as [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) carriers bearing [`gmeow:mediaType`](../properties/gmeow-mediaType.md).

### Examples

- ex:census a [`gmeow:Dataset`](gmeow-Dataset.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:censusTitle; [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) "doi:10.5061/dryad.xyz".
